2861.d: Excuse us we don't have time to play with you.

2862.d: I recognize you! You ruined my plan last time!

2863.d: What? You're the one attacked Turin...

2864.d: Turin!! Damn I should've told Linky about this!

2866.d: You won't need to know this as you're going to die!

2868.d: Why does Linky's minion attacked Turin...

2869.d: Senpai this is not the best time for thinking.

2870.d: Let's go help Ithil and Valeera!

2873.d: It's good... to see no hostile here...

2876.d: No matter what we'll need to take a look first. Everyone stay back.

2877.d: Ithil rose her hand and took off her eye mask.

2878.d: Then she opened the gate and dodged a purple flash.

2879.d: How could she see that in darkness... !!! Valeera is her eye mask... took off...?

2880.d: She's using her Eyes of True Sight now.

2882.d: Ithil what have you seen? What's behind the gate?

2883.d: It appears to be a Terror Figure but I don't feel the same aura.

2884.d: So it just looks alike right?

2885.d: But we still cannot lower our cautiousness I will test that myself!

2888.d: I'm okay it's not a real Terror Figure.

2890.d: The current situation is still acceptable...

2891.d: It looks similar but is much weaker.

2893.d: Since they're not Terror Figures let's clear them out first!

2894.d: Well though the library breeds many strange creatures these are not on the list~

2895.d: Even they're weaker you still need to watch out!

2900.d: Though the movements still seems awkward but it's our skills!

2901.d: Yes... now I know how much they suffered when they took this strike from Ithil!

2902.d: Valeera's skills aim to kill too!

2903.d: I got it! They're the Mimics!

2905.d: Mimics are spawned from the energy of the Terror Figures.

2906.d: According to the research they will fight with everything they meet after being spawned.

2907.d: Copy all the moves optimize them and finally...

2909.d: Correct! But the process to achieve this is lost long ago...

2910.d: It's even before the first invasion!

2914.d: In combat consider talking a method to rest!

2918.d: Now let's get the show on the road!

2921.d: I'm not afraid of her... I just respect her a lot~

2922.d: Since it's just me now I'll show you my real power!!

2923.d: This is Grand Library Ulbricht it is my domain!!

2924.d: My game my turf my rules!

2925.d: Are we here with the same senior?

2926.d: The energy reading is a lot higher than before!

2927.d: That's the reason she could survive the first invasion...

2928.d: Huh? Why are there so many Terror Figures out here?

2931.d: Mimics? Those weaklings who didn't even dare to show up during the last invasion?

2934.d: My weapon won't recognize what it's hitting!!

2937.d: Never thought we could witness how the seniors fight...

2938.d: Now that I think about it this might not be really lucky but...

2939.d: It's dull just sitting here watching! Let's help them defeat the remaining enemies!

2940.d: This is new especially when it comes from Senpai...

2942.d: This is a really good chance and I'm not going to miss it!

2943.d: After this is over this will be a real good story to brag about!

2945.d: But I also want such a story to brag about!

2946.d: After the evil mist is cleared out a broken sword is revealed in the center of the library...

2950.d: The broken sword was picked up by a dark figure

2951.d: Linky charged to the figure with the drill.

2952.d: But it's more like a dance than a fight.

2953.d: For Linky the move is just too familiar.

2955.d: It's so beautiful... I hope there will be a class for the dance...

2956.d: Before that we'd better clear out all the Mimics first!

2958.d: Iron Fist where are you going?

2959.d: Clear out the Mimics! Then I could learn the dance from them!

2964.d: that can clear all the filth in the world

2965.d: And was believed never to be seen again.

2966.d: This is Regiment Alpha of the United Force.

2967.d: We'll be the tip of the sword against the enemy of Yume.

2968.d: "Enigma" should have died in the first invasion but now---

2971.d: I've been searching for you in the last century...

2972.d: Even if all the evidence shows you're dead but I never gave up...

2974.d: Everyone in the hall except Linky is shocked.

2975.d: But the reasons are totally different.

2976.d: Until a rod of flame dropped from the sky.

2982.d: Why did you try to steal the Philosopher's Stone?!

2983.d: And the traitor who leaked the Singularity...

2984.d: Is that you? Answer the question!

2985.d: ... I consider that as acquiescence. I will have my revenge!!

2987.d: Linky! Get out of my way!

2988.d: "Enigma" just smiles. It was just like the smile in the past but there's still something strange.

2989.d: With a wave of her hand more Mimics are summoned.

3000.d: These Mimics won't let us go this easily.

3001.d: Phoenix Linky what do you say?

3002.d: I've got no time to waste!

3006.d: We'd better finish these Mimics off quickly so we could stand a chance to catch up with them...

3007.d: We can just follow the burnt path to track Phoenix.

3008.d: She's a lot different from who she used to be...

3010.d: She used to be a cute girl who always got lost.

3011.d: But after the traitor appeared and ruined everything

3013.d: After that she's full of hatred.

3014.d: She disappeared soon after the war was over

3015.d: I never imagined a reunion like this.

3016.d: The war it changed the lives of many...

3017.d: Uh senpai I think now it's more important to deal with the Mimics that are blocking our way?

3020.d: Bud Elf will be crazy if she knows what happened here!

3021.d: Damn the Discipline Members must be in trouble---

3024.d: All the Discipline Members have been knocked down but luckily none was heavily wounded

3025.d: Seems the flame circle surrounded and protected them. Outside the circle was Phoenix who could barely stand up.

3026.d: She's still protecting them even when her wound is critical...

3028.d: Of course this is not the point---

3029.d: Not far away it was Linky and "Enigma".

3030.d: And apparently they captured two girls with them---

3033.d: I won't let you disturb her.

3034.d: So you just let her hurt others?

3035.d: I believe in her that's all I can say.

3036.d: Even if the behavior seems to be wrong she must have her reasons.

3037.d: But this is no excuse to hurt your fellows!

3038.d: Fellows? Do you mean the weak juniors?

3039.d: Then I've done it for countless times.

3040.d: I used to hurt my teammates a lot in combat and she's the only one who accepted me. Why shouldn't I trust her?

3041.d: The ones I believed have never failed me.

3042.d: But you cannot guarantee you're always correct!

3043.d: I won't consider that much I never did---

3044.d: So all I need to do is to obey her orders!

3045.d: I won't let you hurt the girls anymore!

3048.d: Sorry for being late. Her power is boosted!

3050.d: Finally the seniors are here! We must breach her defense!!

3052.d: It's time to start the ritual.

3055.d: It's alchemy according to the runes drawn it requires 2 opposing powers.

3057.d: Yes they will become the most fitting sacrifice!

3059.d: I don't know what she really wants to do but---

3060.d: Once the ritual is started it cannot be stopped!

3061.d: We must stop her before the alchemy ritual begins!

3062.d: I know but Linky is too strong and the Mimics just keep coming!

3063.d: That's not what you should do to a senior!

3064.d: You're not worthy of my respect!

3065.d: I can do this all day!!

3066.d: Even if she is heavily wounded she still kept fighting...

3067.d: Her speed is not lowered at all...

3068.d: It's not the best time to praise our enemy!

3070.d: So it's impossible to stop the ritual...

3071.d: Wait the air is heating up...

3072.d: When all seems to be lost flame covers Phoenix...

3077.d: What doesn't kill me makes me stronger!!

3078.d: I will never let you anywhere near her!

3079.d: Then turn to ash with her!

3080.d: Now Linky won't be protecting you anymore!

3081.d: So... You are the traitor right?

3083.d: Have you ever felt remorse or fear? Have you ever dreamed of the ones who died because of you?

3084.d: Now I've brought you their greetings!

3085.d: Nothing could be seen from her eyes.

3086.d: Even now... all the ex-friends are here for her.

3087.d: She still refused to say a word.

3089.d: Even heavily wounded Linky still struggles to stand up and stood in front of Phoenix.

3091.d: No one shall stop my revenge!

3094.d: The flame burned through the air but still perished in front of Linky.

3095.d: She's the traitor she betrayed us all! Including you!

3096.d: She is the cause of the all the annihilation!!

3099.d: Phoenix tried to push Linky away but---

3104.d: A blade thrust through the chests of the two seniors and at the edge of it was "Enigma"'s hand.

3105.d: Senpai We need to get Phoenix to safety now!

3106.d: How dare you... She trusted you so much...

3108.d: That's exactly what a traitor will do...

3109.d: Linky fell to the ground with some confusion and some joy...

3110.d: And Phoenix she fell as Linky did but her anger is just driven even fiercer.

3111.d: What doesn't kill me makes me stronger!!

3114.d: The alchemy is using the power of Phoenix!!

3116.d: Power of Light and Dark acquired.

3120.d: This is our last chance let's go!

3122.d: Any idea how to stop it?

3124.d: No matter what we need to get Michael and Lucifer back!

3126.d: I don't care who you are you cannot...

3127.d: The body of Michael and Lucifer started to float around Philosopher's Stone and suddenly---

3129.d: A lightning hit the middle of the alchemy field

3130.d: Philosopher's Stone started to light up the entire space....

3133.d: As the dust gradually dispersed two girls can be seen standing in it...

3135.d: It's good to know you're all safe---

3138.d: Though alike they are different girls.

3139.d: They held each other like they were born so.

3140.d: And the two girls lying in the field seems have passed out...

3145.d: The twins of fate Esau and Jacob were inseparable since they are born.

3146.d: Esau was kind and warm-hearted but Jacob was cold and indifferent.

3147.d: One carries all the beauty and kindness in the world the other have to suffer all the pain and evil.

3150.d: Jacob you're hurt!? Who did this!!

3152.d: It must be those humans again...

3153.d: If I had the Philosopher's Stone...

3156.d: Just trust me I will drive all the misery away from you.

3158.d: (Happiness for victory encouragement from friends desire for survival...)

3159.d: (The key to build the stone is all the emotions that could be found in a war.)

3160.d: (This is recorded in the Genesis page. But...)

3162.d: That's right if you accept the blessing of the Philosopher on that day you can have the stone.

3164.d: (The color of the flame... achieved resonance with the pain and unfortunate inside me...)

3165.d: Find me at the Land of the Beginning， and I will give you the stone.

3166.d: And with the help of it you can release your sister from misery.

3167.d: Thank you I will do that.

3168.d: I'm here as promised please give me your blessing.

3170.d: Doesn't matter. Let's make this quick then Jacob could recover.

3171.d: Hehe... You're right now step on the mud in the centre.

3172.d: (Where is he... His sound is from everywhere...)

3173.d: Esau jumped up and her white wings touched the rock

3174.d: But the feathers dropping from them are black...

3178.d: I knew it was you Jacob. Are you here to steal the blessing from your sister?

3180.d: I... Knew... The blessing... Is just... A lie

3182.d: When the balance is broken and the war begins the Philosopher's Stone will be forged.

3184.d: You're better though the darkness in you is much more powerful than your sister haha.

3185.d: Shut... Up... I will do everything... To protect her...

3186.d: After saying that Jacob lost consciousness. And then...

3188.d: Why is the dark power of Jacob so weak?

3192.d: Jacob why are you here? How do you feel?

3193.d: (That's the reason why the twins are inseparable... She's not alone...)

3197.d: I know I will get it for you!

3200.d: So the first invasion of Chaos begins. But...

3201.d: Damn Yume's force is too hard to defeat!

3203.d: It's time to use someone else.

3209.d: The first Valkyrie the actual leader of Regiment Alpha~

3210.d: Kratos you feel lonely don't you?

3213.d: I know the cute AI~ But does she have a soul?

3215.d: Don't lie to yourself~ She's soulless~

3217.d: Why are you so angry if I'm wrong?

3218.d: You are having more friends and the world is getting more lively but I know what you're thinking.

3221.d: You must know it right? Sooner or later you will leave this world and return to the other side.

3222.d: Yet you still stand the chance to meet again with that soulless toy... but it's slimmer than 0.01%.

3223.d: But what if something could grant her a soul?

3225.d: This is how to forge the stone~

3227.d: You should understand only the purest power could create a soul.

3228.d: Do you want the AI to have a soul?

3229.d: The invasion is almost over~ The window will be closed soon!

3230.d: Will you do this for her...?

3231.d: (Ithil I will give you a fair warning here... You are also my friend but...)

3234.d: Tch after betraying everyone the Philosopher's Stone is still not completed...

3235.d: Jacob... Esau and Philosopher's Stone are all missing...

3236.d: I shall live on. There's still hope if I'm still alive...

3237.d: (I could fake my death and wait...)

3240.d: After the story is over Everyone started to look for the narrator.

3243.d: So Kratos was the Traitor and the AI mentioned is that you?

3244.d: Turin the first generation of Observer created by "Li" artificial intelligence.

3246.d: Turin are you telling the truth...

3247.d: Sorry to keep you waiting so long this is my present for you!!

3251.d: Laughing Kratos rushed to the centre of the circle trying to get Philosopher's Stone...

3252.d: But an attack with Chaos power hit her.

3256.d: The power of Chaos is corrupting her body!

3258.d: Just one more step Kratos could be able to reach Philosopher's stone but she failed.

3259.d: She could only watch but nothing else can be done...

3261.d: The girl with black wings pushed away the girl with white wings and stepped on Kratos' body...

3262.d: Well~ You have no use for me now~

3264.d: Kratos you're really greedy aren't you?

3266.d: You human have flaws in your emotions that's why I could manipulate you all.

3268.d: No one can stop me now!

3269.d: You... you're not the girl! Your power is familiar!

3270.d: Finally someone realized...but you're too late!!!

3273.d: This one believes you've known the whole story.

3274.d: The fact is the truth is noticed by this one for a long time but there's no proper counter measure.

3276.d: Turin I don't care what you are

3277.d: It's not the best time to talk about this... ????

3278.d: A bright light covered the view and the Chaos seems weaker after this...

3279.d: Please don't pursue. According to the calculation the possibility for entering a trap is high!

3281.d: Don't worry the teleportation will need a coordinate to activate!

3282.d: This is our best chance! Plus the possibility is not 100% right?

3283.d: AI will never make a mistake!

3284.d: Don't worry leave it to us!

3285.d: Since that day I've been dreaming the same thing...

3286.d: I can enjoy life everyday with other students...

3287.d: Just like you and your friends... Just like a normal human being...

3288.d: But I can't do that... I'm just an AI Even if this AI has the authority of an Observer...

3289.d: If you have a dream like this you can do that!!

3291.d: I've built a bond with the girls when I'm an Observer.

3293.d: I got my humanity without the help of Philosopher's Stone.

3295.d: Humanity is built with flaws but it's the reason for the diversity of life!

3296.d: At least for me you're not just an AI!

3298.d: You're right I can do this!!!

3299.d: As if sensing some kind of power the Philosopher's Stone shines with blinding light...

3300.d: Senpai it's not the time to zone out! The stone---

3306.d: Do you think you will be still able to defeat us without the stone?

3307.d: It's time to pay for what you have done!

3309.d: 填充文本填充文本填充文本

3310.d: 填充文本填充文本填充文本

3311.d: I will avenge Lucifer and Michael!

3316.d: You know what you have done? You just destroyed my Philosopher's Stone!!

3318.d: You think you have won already? I am eternity! I am your doom!

3321.d: He's gone... It's a pity that we don't have a method to stop him...

3323.d: My drive was badly damaged in the last war. For the past hundred years I've been recovering in campus.

3324.d: After countless reboots I finally succeeded to recover recently.

3325.d: But after that everything seems new to me.

3326.d: Kratos Ithil Phoenix they all disappeared

3330.d: Thanks for the talk it makes me understand that Observer could also gain self-awareness

3331.d: I've never felt my emotion so clearly.

3332.d: Not because of Philosopher's Stone but my own will.

3333.d: No matter what will happen in the following days I shall stand by your side.

3334.d: On the second day of the battle everything in campus has returned normal.

3335.d: No minions no Mimics no Terror Figures no Dire...

3336.d: Linky disappeared with Kratos during the fight with Dire.

3337.d: The Valkyrie each have their own plans;

3338.d: Although Michael and Lucifer are still unconscious but they should be alright as the Ritual didn't succeed in the end.

3339.d: Everything just looked like a dream. And the dreamer is just awaken...

3342.d: You used up your energy and passed out yesterday.

3345.d: But why are you in my dreams?

3346.d: Huh? Still not awake? Want a wake-up exercise?

3350.d: Everything happened yesterday is gone I thought senpai also...

3353.d: Though I've been here for a long time but the data of my student card is reset.

3355.d: So Turin let me show you the Academy first!

3356.d: You must have been doing the same thing for a lot of times~

3357.d: I'm always the friendly senpai to the juniors!

3358.d: Well just like the others described.

3362.d: But currently to be with senpai and others

3363.d: Is the best situation I could imagine~
